sections.title: From ODEs to PDEs: The Leap in Complexity
lecture_lines: ODEs involve one variable changing over time.
PDEs track change across multiple spatial dimensions.
Imagine a ball on a single track.
Now visualize waves rippling across a pond.
animations: Fade in a point moving on a 1D line, labeled 'ODE Path' (#FF5733). Change the lecture line to #FF5733.
Fade in a 2D surface ripple, labeled 'PDE Ripple' (#33FF57). Change the lecture line to #33FF57.
Move the point to grid B5, labeled 'Ball'. Change the lecture line to #FFFFFF.
Move the ripple to grid D2-F6, labeled 'Pond'. Change the lecture line to #FFFFFF.
Highlight both and by flashing their borders simultaneously. Change the lecture line to #FFFFFF.

sections.title: The Heat Equation: A Case Study
lecture_lines: Heat moves through space over time.
Temperature changes depend on local spatial curvature.
Hot spots diffuse toward cooler areas.
animations: Display a 1D metal rod in A2-B5, labeled 'Heat Spike' (#FF0000). Change the lecture line to #FF0000.
Animate the spike diffusing from #FF0000 to #FFFF00 on the rod. Change the lecture line to #FFFF00.
Display a shrinking white vector labeled 'Laplacian' (#FFFFFF) at C4 on the rod. Change the lecture line to #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Boundary and Initial Conditions
lecture_lines: PDEs require context to solve uniquely.
Initial conditions set the state at time zero.
Boundary conditions define constraints at the edges.
animations: Display a heated mat (#4A90E2) in B4-E6 with a central initial condition (#FF5733). Change the lecture line to #4A90E2.
Display the heat map at C5, showing spreading to the boundaries. Change the lecture line to #FF5733.
Display the boundaries darkening, labeled 'Initial Condition' at D5 to lock heat flow on the mat. Change the lecture line to #FFFFFF.

sections.title: The Big Three: Classification
animations: Display a static arch icon at B6 labeled 'Elliptic' (#FFFFFF). Change the lecture line to #FFFFFF.
Display a spreading cloud icon at A3-A6 labeled 'Parabolic' (#FFFF00). Change the lecture line to #FFFF00.
Display a vibrating string icon at F6 labeled 'Hyperbolic' (#FF00FF). Change the lecture line to #FF00FF.

sections.title: Applications and Summary
lecture_lines: PDEs model everything from aerodynamics to finance.
They allow prediction of complex systems.
Mastering them unlocks real-world technological design.
animations: Display a car icon at B2 showing airflow (#50E3C2). Change the lecture line to #50E3C2.
Display a stock ticker graph at C2 (#F5A623). Change the lecture line to #F5A623.
Display both icons and in a summary rect at D3-F6. Change the lecture line to #FFFFFF.
